personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Variant: Space Grotesk / Plus Jakarta Sans)
personality_one_liner: An authoritative, clean, and highly efficient mobile command center for school counselors (Guru BK) to administer AUM Umum, compute deterministic scores, and visualize student wellbeing insights instantly.

spacing.rule: Maintain consistent iOS-native padding rhythms with comfortable vertical spacing and clear grouping of related analytics cards.

do's: Use translucent blurred headers over scrolling content
Apply glass effects on sticky bottom action bars for wizard and analysis screens
dont's: Never apply blur to form input fields or dense data tables
Avoid stacking multiple blur containers on top of each other

screens.name: Auth & Demo Mode
screens.purpose: Secure authentication for Guru BK and one-tap sandbox Demo Mode switch with pre-populated school datasets.

states.loading: Authenticating credentials or seeding demo database...
states.error: Authentication failed. Please check credentials or network connection.

screens.layout: Centered clean branding container with role selection toggle, credential inputs, and a prominent 'Masuk Demo Instan' sandbox launcher button.

screens.name: Dashboard / Home
screens.purpose: At-a-glance command center displaying active school respondent counts, quick action wizards, and high-priority student wellbeing alerts.

states.loading: Loading counselor metrics and respondent summaries...
states.empty: No active school year selected. Tap 'Atur Sekolah' to begin.
states.error: Failed to sync dashboard analytics. Tap to retry.

screens.layout: Scrollable vertical container with sticky header, school context switcher banner, 2-column KPI metric cards, quick-launch AUM Format selector, and recent respondent logs.

screens.name: Database Sekolah & Kelas
screens.purpose: Hierarchical management of schools, academic years, educational levels, classes, and respondent student lists with import/export capabilities.

states.loading: Fetching institutional hierarchy and student records...
states.empty: No classes registered yet. Add a class or import Excel template.
states.error: Failed to load database. Please retry connection.

screens.layout: Segmented level selector (SD, SLTP, SLTA, PT, Masyarakat), expandable class accordion list, floating action button for new respondent, and Excel/PDF action sheet.

screens.name: AUM Input Wizard
screens.purpose: Step-by-step 3-step questionnaire wizard for respondent problem selection, severe problem flagging, and supplemental information.

states.error: Failed to save questionnaire step progress.

screens.layout: Progress indicator header, step card with category tabs, tappable statement items with visual selection state, and sticky bottom navigation bar with 'Lanjut' and 'Simpan'.

screens.name: Deterministic Scoring & Individual Results
screens.purpose: Calculates and displays individual AUM profile scores across problem areas with confidential, non-diagnostic guidance notes.

states.empty: No scoring data available for this respondent.
states.error: Scoring calculation error. Check audit logs.

screens.layout: Summary score card with category breakdown bars, confidential badge indicator, actionable counseling recommendations, and PDF export toolbar.

screens.name: Group & Class Profile Analysis
screens.purpose: Aggregates class-wide responses to visualize problem rankings, severity distributions, and group comparisons.

states.loading: Aggregating class responses and generating rankings...
states.empty: No respondents recorded for this class yet.

screens.layout: Ranked horizontal bar charts per problem area, filterable by gender/category, with a class comparison selector and batch export button.

screens.name: Audit & System Settings
screens.purpose: Provides complete transparency through calculation audit logs, database backups, data purging, and audit trail records.

states.loading: Loading audit trails and system backup status...

screens.layout: Tabbed audit log viewer with timestamped scoring steps, backup management card with export/import controls, and secure data wipe confirmation modal.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the AUM Umum BK Mobile app using React Native, Expo Router, and TypeScript. Ensure strict adherence to safe areas, touch targets >= 44x44pt, loading/empty/error states on every screen, and sticky bottom CTAs. Utilize botanical teal palette (#0F766E) as brand primary with warm neutral surfaces. Implement the deterministic scoring engine supporting Formats 1 through 5 (75 to 265 items), Demo Mode sandbox toggle, Excel/PDF export UI simulation, and full audit logging.
